d:
Anant Singh ke ghar bahubliyon ka jamavra, Surajbhan Singh ke dost bhi pahunche, Brijbhushan Singh bhi...
Anant sinh ke ghar aaj unki beti ki shadi ke avsar par kaee charchit netaon aur prabhavshali chehron ka jamavra dekhne ko mila. brijbhushan sinh, rama sinh aur sushil sinh samet kaee jani-mani hastiyon ki maujudgi ne is samaroh ko charcha men la diya aur ise rajnitik va samajik shakti pradarshan ke taur par bhi dekha ja raha hai.
